GenericEnabled.Name: Enable generic automations
GenericEnabled.Hint: Enable persistent events, synchronization and timers.

GenericDebug.Name: Automation diagnostic logs
GenericDebug.Hint: Log automation diagnostics to the browser console.

AutoDiscovery.Name: Automatically discover item automations
AutoDiscovery.Hint: Item declarations require explicit GM approval before execution.

TrustedTable.Name: Trusted Table Mode — automatic PF1AE scripts
TrustedTable.Hint: WARNING: Enable only in a private world with trusted players. Player-editable JavaScript Item Script Calls may execute with GM privileges when a player is absent. Disabled by default; individual approvals are preserved.

AutoRange.Name: Automatic ranged increment penalties
AutoRange.Hint: Apply range increment penalties to native PF1 ranged weapon attack rolls against one unambiguous target. Existing explicit range modifiers take priority. Scene grids must use meters or feet.

MigrationBackups.Name: Macro backups before migration
MigrationBackups.Hint: Backup copies of macro commands rewritten during module migration.

MigrationVersion.Name: Module namespace migration
MigrationVersion.Hint: Technical status of migrating settings and flags from the previous module.

ReloadEnabled.Name: Automatic weapon reload tracking (experimental)
ReloadEnabled.Hint: Opt-in tracking for configured firearms and crossbows. Native PF1 continues to consume ammunition. Requires manual per-weapon configuration; disabled by default.

Range.OutOfRange: PF1AE: Target is out of range. The attack was not modified; check the target and weapon range.

Effects.NotOwner: You do not control this character.

Discovery.GMOnly: Only the elected active GM can perform this operation.
Discovery.NoDeclaration: This item has no automations declaration.

Reload.AoO: Reloading normally provokes an attack of opportunity.
Reload.Unconfigured: Reload tracking is not configured for this weapon.
Reload.SettingsHint: Opt-in tracking for configured firearms and crossbows. Native PF1 continues to consume ammunition. Requires manual per-weapon configuration; disabled by default.
Reload.NoAmmo: No native ammunition Item found in this actor's inventory. Add an Item of type Ammunition (ammo), not a general loot object.
Reload.NoActions: This weapon has no native attack actions. Create an attack action in its PF1 Actions tab first.
